description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class, which implements a middleware component for Guzzle HTTP client to handle request retries based on custom logic. It manages retry policies, delay strategies, and integrates with Guzzle's promise system.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware that retries HTTP requests based on a user-defined decider function, supporting configurable delay strategies and integrated with Guzzle's promise system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the retry middleware with a decider function, a next handler, and an optional delay function.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Static method providing a default exponential delay based on retry count in milliseconds.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, executing the request and setting up promise handlers for fulfillment and rejection.

methods.name: onFulfilled
methods.description: Creates a callback to handle successful responses, deciding whether to retry based on the decider function.

methods.name: onRejected
methods.description: Creates a callback to handle request failures, deciding whether to retry based on the decider function.

methods.name: doRetry
methods.description: Performs a retry by calculating delay and re-invoking the middleware.
